scoring_justification: The headline quantities are DFT-computed tensors; the verifier cannot re-run DFT, so the submitted values are compared to the paper's reported reference with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference elastic dipole and migration volume tensors for Al (3x3x3 supercell)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3, row for Al, 3×3×3 supercell (vacancy and transition state) and derived migration volume tensor
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values transcribed directly from the paper text (Eqs. 23-27 and Table 3).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The paper explicitly reports these numeric tensors for the required supercell size; no external data is needed.

required.vacancy_dipole: list of list of float (3x3 matrix)
required.transition_dipole: list of list of float (3x3 matrix)
required.migration_volume_tensor: list of list of float (3x3 matrix)

outputs.description: Final computed tensors: vacancy elastic dipole P_vac, transition-state elastic dipole P_ts, and migration-volume tensor ΔV. Each is a 3x3 array of floats. The hidden checker compares every component to the paper's reference 3×3×3 supercell values within tolerances; score is fraction of components in agreement.

output_contract.notes: All DFT calculations must use the 3×3×3 supercell and the specified elastic constants. The solver may use external compute resources; only the final JSON must be placed under /app/outputs.
